prompt:
Style: japanese-retro-manga. Transform the supplied ORIGINAL photograph of a LEGO Millennium Falcon model on a white cabinet, minifigures, a display plaque and nearby autumn foliage. Render only a single full-frame artwork using this style treatment:

- **artwork — selection.** Pick the photo's most recognizable subject or gesture; remove most unnecessary background and clutter. - **artwork — style.** Redraw it as a large retro comic advertisement illustration: thick irregular black ink outlines, solid black shadows, white highlights, selective hatching, and simplified flat color. - **Palette.** A mainly white background with black outlines and shadows, plus one main accent color taken from the photo (a second photo-derived accent only if needed), combined with black-and-white contrast — a retro feel without becoming too old or complicated. Subjects sometimes cover letters and letters sometimes emerge behind subjects, with offset shadows for depth and movement. - **Texture.** Restrained halftone dots, ink grain, hatching, and slight print misregistration. - **Checklist.** Layout accuracy, photo fidelity, the huge headline, subject–headline overlap, a recognizable illustration, and clean white space. 

Preserve the original scene's subject relationships. Every part of the canvas must belong to the transformed artwork. No original photo panel, no before/after comparison, no split, no text.
